rules.description: NIC must maintain a database that includes all stakeholders and their contact details.
rules.outcome: A database of all stakeholders with contact details is kept.
rules.evidence_quote: A database of all the stakeholders containing contact details etc. will be maintained by NIC.

rules.description: NIC must update the stakeholder database whenever any stakeholder information changes and provide the updated database to any concerned stakeholder upon request.
rules.condition: Whenever a change occurs in stakeholder information.
rules.outcome: NIC takes necessary steps to update the database and makes it available to concerned stakeholders as per their requirement.
rules.evidence_quote: NIC will take necessary steps to update this database, whenever a change occurs, and make this available to concerned stakeholders as per their requirement.
